title: Höhenhorn Schilthorn Men's Softshell Jacket — with Hood, Dark Blue
short_description: Men's softshell jacket by Höhenhorn (Schilthorn model) in dark blue: 94% polyester, 6% elastane, with hood and several pockets.
long_description: The Höhenhorn Schilthorn is a men's softshell jacket with a hood in dark blue. According to Amazon it is made of 94% polyester and 6% elastane and is meant for hiking, trekking tours and everyday use. The high-closing zip is said to protect against wind and keep body heat in. There are two longitudinal side pockets and chest pockets for extra storage, plus a faux leather patch on the hood. According to Amazon the fit is regular and the jacket is listed for autumn, winter and spring. Before buying, please check sizes and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
